## About
Don's Auto Body is an independent, family owned business serving San Francisco and the Bay Area. We fix all makes and models, and we are the exclusive dealer approved body shop for San Francisco Honda.
As a Direct Repair Facility for many insurance companies, including AAA, we take care of the necessary paperwork so you can focus on getting back on the road.
Our customers rate us 4.2 from 48 Google reviews. One reviewer who drives for Lyft and Uber got their car back before the weekend, and another called the communication and transparency excellent.

## Services
- Collision repair: Body repair after an accident, for all makes and models.
- Free repair estimates: Free, detailed, computerized estimates so you know what to expect.
- Auto glass replacement: Glass work done by our own in-house glass company.
- Towing: Towing for cars that can't be driven or aren't safe to drive.
- Paintless dent repair: Dents taken out without repainting.
- Window tint: Window tint installation.
- Detailing: Detailing to take care of your car's cosmetic needs.
- Clear Guard bumper protection: Clear Guard sales and installation to help prevent dings in your bumper.
- Rental car reservations: We make your rental car reservation for you.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on my kind of car?
A: Yes. We repair all makes and models.

Q: How quickly will I hear back if I call or email?
A: You'll get a response within 24 hours. For something more urgent, call the shop and ask for any of us by name.

Q: Can you handle mechanical maintenance too?
A: Mechanical maintenance is taken care of through San Francisco Honda.
